products.body_html:
ONESPORT OT07 Electric Trekking E-Bike

The ONESPORT OT07 is designed for riders who want a reliable and comfortable electric bike for commuting and long-distance riding. Built with a full aluminum alloy frame, the OT07 combines durability, lightweight construction, and modern design. It is available in two stylish colors: Shell White and Matte Black.

Powerful Mid-Drive Performance

The bike is powered by a BAFANG 36V 250W mid-drive motor delivering up to 80Nm of torque. Combined with the integrated BAFANG torque sensor, the motor adjusts assistance based on your pedaling force, creating a smooth, natural riding experience on city roads or uphill climbs.

Long Range Battery

Equipped with a 36V 14Ah lithium battery using EVE 18650 cells, the OT07 offers an estimated 90–110 km range in pedal-assist mode. Actual performance may vary depending on terrain, temperature, rider weight, and riding conditions. Charging the battery takes approximately 6–8 hours.

Comfort & Safety

For reliable braking performance, the OT07 features front and rear hydraulic disc brakes with 160mm rotors and power-cut brake levers. The aluminum suspension fork with 80mm travel absorbs bumps and improves comfort on uneven roads. The bike rides on 700×45C tires, offering stability and grip for both commuting and trekking.

Riding Experience

The OT07 includes 5 levels of pedal assist and a Shimano 1×7-speed drivetrain, allowing riders to easily adapt to different terrains. The electric assist is limited to 25 km/h in accordance with local regulations, but riders can still pedal faster using their own power.

Built with a stable four-wheel design, the YL-02G delivers enhanced balance and smooth handling, ideal for riders who prioritize safety and confidence while riding. The low step-through frame also makes mounting and dismounting effortless.
